$comment: The three festival events, in journey order (SFC -> UTS -> Main). `id` is also the colour theme. `title` lines + `script` build the big display title. Media keys refer to media.json.

items.name: Short Film Competition
title: Short Film
Competition
items.tagline: New voices, short stories, one night.
items.summary: Emerging Indonesian and Indonesian-Australian filmmakers compete with short films judged by an industry panel. Finalists are screened on the night and winners announced live.
description: The Short Film Competition opens the festival journey. Every year we call for short films from students, first-time directors and independent filmmakers across Indonesia and Australia.
Finalists screen in front of a live audience and an industry jury. Awards include Best Short Film, Best Director and the Audience Choice Award, voted on the night.
Submission details for the 21st edition will be announced soon.

items.name: UTS Screening
title: UTS
Screening
items.tagline: A night between the shorts and the main event.
items.summary: A special screening event bridging the competition and the main festival: a feature film, conversation and community night.
description: The UTS Screening is the second stop on the festival journey: a feature screening followed by a conversation with the filmmakers.
Full details for the 21st edition will be announced soon.

items.name: Main Screening
title: Main
Screening
items.tagline: Three days of Indonesian cinema at ACMI.
items.summary: The heart of the festival: feature films from Indonesia's most exciting filmmakers, panel discussions and Q&As at ACMI.
description: The Main Screening is the festival's flagship weekend at ACMI: a curated program of recent Indonesian features, many screening in Australia for the first time.
Between screenings, join panels and Q&As with directors, actors and producers. All films screen with English subtitles.
